camel_example: aliyun cloudfw ListApplications --region cn-hangzhou --CategoryId 8 --GroupName Dingtalk --ApplicationName '钉钉' --Description '办公' --PageSize 10 --Technology '基于浏览器' --Risk Low --CategoryName '办公协作' --Lang zh --PageNo 1 --ApplicationId 10012150000
description_en: Queries the applications in the built-in application signature library by using paging. Supports fuzzy match by application name, description, technology type, category name, and group name, exact filtering by application ID and category ID, and filtering by risk level. The query targets the global built-in application library regardless of the Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 分页查询内置应用特征库中的应用程序列表。支持按应用名称、描述、技术类型、分类名称和分组名称模糊搜索，按应用ID和分类ID精确过滤，按风险等级过滤。查询对象为全局内置应用库，不区分阿里云账号
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw list-applications --lang zh --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --application-name '钉钉' --description '办公' --application-id 10012150000 --category-id 8 --technology '基于浏览器' --risk Low --category-name '办公协作' --group-name Dingtalk --api-version 2017-12-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApplications

parameters.help_en:
The language of the returned information. Valid values:
zh: Chinese. This is the default value.
en: English.
This parameter determines whether the application name, category name, technology type, vendor, and description are returned in Chinese or English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言。取值：
zh：中文，为默认值。
en：英文。
该参数决定应用名称、分类名称、技术类型、厂商和描述使用中文或英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值需大于等于1，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The application name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序名称，模糊匹配
parameters.name: application_name

parameters.help_en: The application description. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用程序描述信息，模糊匹配
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Exact match is supported
parameters.name: application_id

parameters.help_en: The application category ID. Exact match is supported
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The technology type name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 技术类型名称，模糊匹配
parameters.name: technology

parameters.help_en:
The risk level. Exact match is supported. Valid values:
Information: Informational.
Low: Low.
Medium: Medium.
High: High.
Critical: Critical.
If an invalid value is passed, this filter condition is ignored
parameters.help_zh:
风险等级，精确匹配。取值：
Information：信息。
Low：低危。
Medium：中危。
High：高危。
Critical：严重。
传入非法值时该过滤条件被忽略
parameters.name: risk

parameters.help_en: The application category name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用分类名称，模糊匹配
parameters.name: category_name

parameters.help_en: The application group name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用分组名称，模糊匹配
parameters.name: group_name

Applications.description_en: The list of applications. In the Chinese environment, the applications are sorted in descending order of group name and ascending order of application level
Applications.description_zh: 应用程序列表。中文环境下按分组名称降序、应用等级升序排列

ApplicationId.description_en: The application ID in the built-in application signature library
ApplicationId.description_zh: 内置应用特征库中的应用程序ID

ApplicationName.description_en: The application name. The name is returned in Chinese or English based on the Lang parameter
ApplicationName.description_zh: 应用程序名称，按Lang参数返回中文或英文名称

CategoryName.description_en: The application category name. The name is returned in Chinese or English based on the Lang parameter
CategoryName.description_zh: 应用分类名称，按Lang参数返回中文或英文名称

DefaultAction.description_en: The default action for the application in the built-in application library. The value is fixed as Alert (Monitor)
DefaultAction.description_zh: 内置应用库中该应用程序的默认动作，固定为Alert（观察）

Description.description_en: The application description. The description is returned in Chinese or English based on the Lang parameter
Description.description_zh: 应用程序描述信息，按Lang参数返回中文或英文描述
Description.example: 企业级智能移动办公与协同平台，提供即时通讯、音视频会议、组织管理、在线文档、审批考勤及AI办公助理等功能

Level.description_en: The level value of the application. The value is obtained from the built-in application signature library and used for list sorting
Level.description_zh: 应用程序的等级数值，取自内置应用特征库，用于列表排序

Protocol.description_en: The list of protocols used by the application
Protocol.description_zh: 应用程序使用的协议列表

Requirements.description_en: The list of detection prerequisites for the application
Requirements.description_zh: 应用程序的检测前提条件列表

items.description_en: The detection prerequisite. SSL indicates that TLS inspection must be enabled, SSH indicates that deep SSH inspection is required, and none indicates that no additional prerequisites are required
items.description_zh: 检测前提条件。SSL表示需要启用TLS检查，SSH表示需要SSH深度检测，none表示无额外前提条件

Risk.description_en:
The risk level. Valid values:
Information: Informational.
Low: Low.
Medium: Medium.
High: High.
Critical: Critical
Risk.description_zh:
风险等级。取值：
Information：信息。
Low：低危。
Medium：中危。
High：高危。
Critical：严重

Technology.description_en: The technology type name. The name is returned in Chinese or English based on the Lang parameter
Technology.description_zh: 技术类型名称，按Lang参数返回中文或英文名称

UpdatedTime.description_en: The last update time of the application information. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 应用程序信息的最近更新时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒

Vendor.description_en: The application vendor name. The name is returned in Chinese or English based on the Lang parameter
Vendor.description_zh: 应用程序厂商名称，按Lang参数返回中文或英文名称

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of applications that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的应用程序总数
